title: Slovakian Kielbasa Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with Slovakian sausage, inspired by the hearty dishes of Eastern Europe. Serve with steamed vegetables or over rice for a filling meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced kielbasa and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of water.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the kielbasa and vegetables, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over rice or with steamed vegetables.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or green onions, if desired.
